subject: Business case: 2x Senior SRE hires for infra capacity (Q4->Q1)
messages:
From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, sara.jenkins@talentoworks.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Business case: 2x Senior SRE hires for infra capacity (Q4->Q1)

Team —

Following up from last week's capacity review: we need formal approval to open two Senior SRE roles focused on runtime/infrastructure reliability and throughput engineering. I attached a short business case (infra_capacity_case_2SREs.pdf) and a proposed comp band sheet (comp-band-proposal.xlsx). High-level ask: approve two net-new FTEs (not backfills), Senior level, target hire window Dec -> Feb.

Why now:
- Traffic growth projection: model serving + embeddings pipelines expected to increase sustained load ~40% by Jan; current on-call rota is at 1.6x capacity and incident MTTR has ticked up.
- Skill set gap: we need people with deep GPU orchestration + batch/streaming autoscaling experience to reduce token latency variance and lower unit cost.
- Risk: without hires we'll need to increase burst reserved capacity (costly) or accept higher latency for some SLAs.

Role summary (for job req):
- Senior SRE, 5+ years infra/runtime experience, strong in GKE/eks-like systems, GPU infra, autoscaling and observability.
- Focus areas: routing/caching resilience, runtime batching improvements, oncall ownership for low-latency serving.

Budget ask: two FTEs, comp band proposal attached; estimated fully-burdened cost FY27 ~ $460k - $520k (range depending on comp outcomes). We are asking for provisional headcount approval so recruiting can start sourcing (TalentOwks listed here). Final offers will come back through hiring committee and comp review.

Request: Rishi/Marcus — can you review and provide provisional approval (yes/no + any constraints) or list follow-ups? If helpful I can set a 30-minute sync.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: infra_capacity_case_2SREs.pdf (pdf), comp-band-proposal.xlsx (xlsx)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, sara.jenkins@talentoworks.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Business case: 2x Senior SRE hires for infra capacity (Q4->Q1)

Kim —

Thanks for the writeup and the attachments. Quick questions before I can greenlight: 
1) Are these 2 strictly new headcount, or is there any internal conversion planned? You said net-new but want to confirm.
2) What is the expected time-to-productivity (TTP) you used for the cost calculation? If it's 6 months that's fine; if it's longer we need to account for interim contractor spend.
3) Can we take one role as Senior + one as Staff SRE (slightly higher bar but reduces headcount risk later)? Marcus — any preference based on upcoming infra roadmap?

I can do a 30-minute sync today at 4pm PT if that helps move this quickly. From my side I lean toward approving 1.5 headcount effectively (approve both on a provisional basis) but want to confirm the finance cadence — do we need to route to Finance/FP&A for FY27 operating carve-out now or can we use a provisional hiring buffer?

- Rishi
VP, Platform Engineering

From: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, sara.jenkins@talentowks.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Business case: 2x Senior SRE hires for infra capacity (Q4->Q1)

Kim / Rishi —

I reviewed the doc and the comp bands. A few notes: 
- Confirmed: these are net-new roles (no available internal conversions that match the GPU/serving expertise).
- TTP: I used 5 months for the FY27 headcount math (conservative). If we hire strong Seniors the ramp could be faster ~3-4 months for operational ownership.
- Cost: comp-band-proposal.xlsx has recommended ranges: $180k-$230k base + equity & benefits; fully-burdened each ~ $230k. That aligns with market and keeps us competitive.

Proposal: approve both reqs to open with the following constraints: 
1) One role advertised as Senior SRE (target 180-210 base), second can be posted as Senior/Staff (120-day window to move to Staff if we find exceptional candidate).
2) Recruiting to prioritize internal/near-payable converts first; external search parallel with TalentOwks.
3) Finance sign-off required before extending offers > $230k base.

If Rishi is ok I can mark these as provisionally approved and ask Growth/Finance to reserve the budget. Grace — can you confirm capacity for interview panel and earliest possible onsite loop?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Dir, Runtime Platforms

Team —

Following our sync this morning and reviewing Marcus' constraints, HR and I are comfortable approving these two reqs provisionally. Action items & conditions: 
- Headcount: 2 net-new Senior SRE reqs approved provisionally.
- Comp constraints: offers up to $230k base approved without additional escalation; anything above requires Finance/Comp committee sign-off (route via JIRA-HR-4571).
- Interview loop: use interview-loop-v1.docx (attached). Target first onsite loop by Jan 15. TalentOwks to provide first candidate slate by Dec 10.
- Finance: Marcus/PF&A to confirm FY27 operating carve-out by Nov 20. Final offer letters cannot be sent until Finance confirms.

Sara (TalentOwks) — please confirm earliest slate & confirm that you will prioritize candidates with GPU orchestration + production serving experience. Please upload candidate shortlists to the Drive folder above.

Kim — please proceed to open the reqs in Greenhouse and loop me on the postings. I'll mark the reqs as "provisionally approved" in the HR tracker; once Marcus confirms Finance carve-out we can move to full approval and start extending offers.

Grateful for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
